Do not recolor near-complete rows/columns, and do not infer lines from mostly-9 density. This exact recurrence guidance should be reused on future inputs with this task id; do not reuse this instance's dimensions/line indices, re-detect from each new grid.

- Preserve dimensions and all original values outside the union of fully uniform separator-color rows/columns. A complete line means every cell in the row/column equals the separator color.
